name: field-kit
description: Work out an event plan for your scaling company: what competitors are doing, where your buyers gather, which companies to meet, a 13-week calendar with costs, and a ledger of what each event produced.

interface.shortDescription: Work out an event plan for your scaling company
interface.longDescription: Give it your company name or website. It shows what your competitors are doing, where your buyers gather and which companies you want in the room, then builds a 13-week event calendar with costs and tracks what each event produced. Works best with an Exa API key.
